coordinates: 720x576 file pixels; x right, y down. Approximate manual observations by Astra GPT, not instrument-grade ground truth.
selection: Reviewed computed frames only. 39/64 are cropped. Whiskers may be clipped in later frames; chosen central landmarks remain visible. No hidden joints or left/right leg identity assigned.
split: First two frames of each shot calibrate; next two are held out. Shots may reuse animation and are not independent samples.
unmeasured: Leg overlap and absence of a marked ground plane prevent reliable side-specific joint or contact-time annotations at this sample density. Do not treat the lowest visible toe as a measured planted foot.
